sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Ownership and Cross-Border Sub-Licensing of Trademarks and Patents

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Republic of Vanuatu (unitary national corporate registry administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; International Company regime)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law and French Civil Code heritage; company law follows Commonwealth offshore jurisprudence)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu-People's Republic of China Bilateral Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (signed 2006)
PACER-Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus) (in force 2020)
Melanesian Spearhead Group Trade Agreement (in force 2005)
No double taxation avoidance agreements (DTAAs) in force - Vanuatu levies no national direct income tax

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2021 (No. 15 of 2021) and AML/CFT Regulations 2022; Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap. 256] (as amended); International Companies Act [Cap. 222] (as amended); Companies Act [Cap. 191] as amended by the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2019 and the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2019; VFSC AML/CFT Guidance Notes and Beneficial Ownership Reporting Directives

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille Convention not in force for Vanuatu)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certificate of Incumbency and Register of Directors, Officers and Shareholders
Beneficial Ownership Declaration Form (UBO Register Extract)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Directors and Licensed Vanuatu Registered Agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered Agent Consent Letter and Business Contact Person Designation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all beneficial owners, directors, officers, authorized signatories and material counterparties against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK HMT Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, Australian DFAT Consolidated List and VFSC/Vanuatu FIU-designated persons; politically exposed persons (PEPs) and medium-risk IP licensing entities are subject to enhanced due diligence (EDD), source-of-funds verification and enhanced ongoing monitoring for cross-border SWIFT royalty wire flows under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2021 and FATF Recommendation 10/12 standards.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) corporate registry - official name clearance and online search facility at www.vfsc.vu
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in Latin script and are accepted in English or French (both official languages); non-Latin script names require certified transliteration by a licensed registered agent; statutory suffixes required: Limited, Ltd, Corporation, Corp, Incorporated, Inc. or Societe Anonyme (SA); names must not be misleading, obscene or confusingly similar to an existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations may be renewed for one further 30-day period upon payment of the applicable VFSC fee. If clearance is refused, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies at VFSC within 14 days of the refusal notice, stating the grounds and attaching a fresh search certificate; an adverse decision may be further challenged by way of judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu within 30 days. Government fees are non-refundable.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for an International Company engaged exclusively in cross-border IP holdco and patent/licensing activities: the statutory registered office must be the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila or Luganville, and no physical office presence in Vanuatu is required; board and shareholder meetings may be convened remotely by teleconference or written resolution.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (approximately 10% annual probability) for a passive IP licensing entity maintaining statutory records (share register, UBO register, minutes) with a reputable licensed agent; VFSC retains risk-based inspection and document production powers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name clearance and reservation fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Bundled within registered agent annual fee; no separate statutory charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent compliance file and business contact person setup
Notarization and consular legalization of incorporation documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public licensed in Vanuatu and Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs / Consular post
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark (Hague Apostille not available)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial ownership register preparation and VFSC filing
AML/CFT, PEP and sanctions screening of UBOs and counterparties
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for enhanced due diligence

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Vanuatu), ss. 5-12 (incorporation procedure), s. 15 (registered office), s. 19 (registered agent); International Companies (Fees and Forms) Regulations 1993
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registry of International Companies, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Form 1 — Application for Incorporation under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; incorporation may proceed with zero or nominal issued share capital (e.g., 1 share of USD 1). No escrow account or capital deposit is required, and shares may be issued for non-cash consideration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers named in the Memorandum of Association be and are hereby allotted the subscribed shares, recorded as issued and fully paid in the register of members. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be established at the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, who is authorized to accept service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the directors named in the register be appointed as the first board with full authority to open bank accounts, execute global trademark and patent licensing agreements, appoint sub-agents, and file all statutory returns with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC — International Companies Registry (via licensed Registered Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit one to three proposed company names to the VFSC for availability check and reservation; ensure the name does not contain prohibited words (e.g., Assurance, Bank, Trust) unless a separate licence is held.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copy of each proposed shareholder and director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, re-file with a modified name or file an appeal letter with the Registrar within 14 calendar days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent / local counsel in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the ICA [Cap 222]; obtain the registered agent's consent and the directors' consents to act, and confirm the registered office address.
required_dossiers: Proof of identity and residential address for directors and beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct defective schedules and re-execute the documents; VFSC will accept amendments on re-submission without prejudice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry of International Companies — Port Vila counter or authorized electronic submission channel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 1 — Application for Incorporation together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, registered agent consent, notice of registered office, and the prescribed incorporation fee; retain the stamped fee receipt.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any VFSC query letter within 14 calendar days; file supplementary declarations or pay additional fees if the application is re-categorised as complex.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation which evidences the legal existence of the International Company; the company thereafter adopts its statutory books, common seal (optional), and corporate records.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request a certified true copy from the Registry if the certificate is lost or defective; pay the applicable certified copy fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolutions and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pass the first board written resolution to approve share allotment, adopt the registered office, appoint directors and secretary, authorise opening of bank accounts, and approve execution of global trademark and patent licensing agreements.
required_dossiers: Minutes or written resolution of the first board meeting
Appointment forms for directors and secretary
Bank account opening package (resolution, passport copies, reference letter)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Pass a subsequent ratifying resolution to cure any procedural defect and maintain the resolution in the statutory records.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Statutory Maintenance and Tax Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC / Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the annual return and pay the VFSC annual licence fee before the anniversary of incorporation; assess economic substance and CRS obligations, and maintain transfer pricing documentation for intercompany royalty flows.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: File late returns with the applicable late penalty; submit a remedial declaration to the Registry to restore good standing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives — business licence office; not applicable to International Companies, which are exempt from the Business Licence Act [Cap 242] for foreign-source IP income
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Exempt — no industrial operating licence; the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation plus annual licence fee constitutes the sole authorisation required for the IP HoldCo

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no physical project, construction, or land development; intellectual property licensing generates no environmental footprint
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — no wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste streams; if a counterparty requires evidence, a DEPC written exemption confirmation can be obtained

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable — no physical premises, employees, or factory floor; compliance limited to maintenance of a registered office and statutory records under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Vanuatu; e-service portal: https://customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu imposes no income-tax TIN requirement, and an International Company (IC) is statutorily tax-exempt. A VAT/TIN registration number is obtained from DCIR using Form IRV-001 via the ePortal when aggregate taxable supplies reach VT 10,000,000 in any rolling 12-month period or when voluntary registration is elected. Foreign applicants file a certified copy of the certificate of incorporation, registered-agent certificate, director and ultimate beneficial owner passport copies, and a declaration of intended supplies; the licensed registered agent facilitates filing, and DCIR issues the VAT/TIN number within 7–14 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections exist. The IC automatically enjoys the statutory offshore tax exemption under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], covering income, withholding, capital gains, and duties. It may elect in its constitution to become an ordinary Vanuatu company, thereby forfeiting the exemption, and may voluntarily elect VAT registration before the statutory threshold; no hybrid entity election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 12 of 2023, administered by the Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 10,000,000 aggregate taxable supplies (including zero-rated export supplies) in any rolling 12-month period, approximately USD 83,000; voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping, or digital-seal regime is in force as of the classification date. Registered taxpayers must issue full VAT tax invoices within 21 days of supply, retain records in the DCIR ePortal, and comply with phased e-invoicing guidance; ASYCUDA World is used for customs declarations.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods are zero-rated when physically exported from Vanuatu within 60 days of supply and evidenced by customs documentation. Services are zero-rated when supplied to a non-resident recipient located outside Vanuatu and the benefit is enjoyed wholly outside Vanuatu; accordingly, cross-border royalty and patent sub-licensing streams invoiced by the IC to foreign licensees qualify for 0% VAT. Exempt financial and offshore services remain outside the VAT net.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World) for goods; zero-rated services schedule in VAT return for IP royalties
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export of goods from Vanuatu
Commercial invoice and underlying patent/trademark licence or sub-licence agreement identifying the non-resident licensee
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT credit advice evidencing receipt of the royalty from outside Vanuatu
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DCIR audits export evidence, licence agreements, and inward payment flows. Incorrect zero-rating attracts a late-payment penalty of 25% and misdeclaration penalties of up to 100% of the tax avoided; fraudulent zero-rating claims are criminal offences punishable by fine and imprisonment, with retrospective assessments unlimited in cases of fraud or wilful misrepresentation. The Commissioner may claw back VAT, penalties, and interest from the entity and, where applicable, its directors.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberalised exchange control environment for non-resident-owned International Companies. Current account payments, including royalty and licence fee repatriations, are freely convertible without prior RBV approval. Capital account inflows and outflows, including shareholder equity injections and capital returns, are also generally unrestricted for ICs; however, practical hurdles arise from the limited depth of the VUV/USD market, which requires banks to pre-book large conversions and to apply the RBV-sanctioned dealing rates. No profit remittance tax or capital gains tax applies to an IP HoldCo, but the bank will require a complete economic-substance and source-of-funds record before processing large licence-related payments.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu does not impose a fixed statutory timeline for export proceeds surrender, and there is no mandatory conversion ratio for foreign-currency export receipts. A Vanuatu International Company may retain royalty and licensing income in original currency, usually USD, in a clearing account. Where a local VUV transaction is necessary, conversion occurs at the commercial bank's prevailing buying rate. The licensing entity is not subject to any requirement to convert export receipts into VUV, provided the funds are used for legitimate offshore treasury purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BSP Vanuatu (Bank of South Pacific Limited)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational USD Account
Operational Account with Treasury Dealing Line
Domestic Operational Account for VUV Settlements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Vanuatu does not have a dedicated electronic money institution (EMI) licensing regime, and foreign offshore digital EMIs cannot obtain deposit-taking or clearing status under the RBV banking supervision framework. A foreign EMI may be used only as a supplementary payment channel after the core treasury banking relationship is established; all inbound and outbound funds must remain in the name of the actual Vanuatu International Company to avoid creating an unlicensed money-services business. The primary clearing route must remain a tier-1 licensed domestic bank with correspondent banking relationships.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory. At least one natural-person director, the ultimate beneficial owner, and any proposed mandated officer must attend an in-person onboarding interview at the selected commercial bank or with an RBV-accredited introducing agent. Fully remote opening is generally not available for an International Company with non-resident shareholders and an intangible-asset business model. Where a foreign corporate shareholder already holds a banking relationship with the same international banking group, a step-in interview may be accepted for that shareholder, but the Vanuatu entity itself must still complete a local KYC file.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-jurisdictional UBO chain involving Vanuatu International Companies, trusts, and non-resident corporate shareholders that cannot readily demonstrate control or source of wealth.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified UBO declaration, original or notarised passports of all natural persons with control, registered agent confirmation certificate, apostilled trust deed and corporate register, signed shareholder/control attestations, independent counsel legal opinion on ownership chain, and sworn source-of-wealth statement supported by audited financial statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Royalty and licence fee cash flows from an IP licensing HoldCo that lack clear commercial purpose, economic substance, or transfer-pricing backing, creating a tax-exempt conduit or round-tripping red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered trademark or patent portfolio schedule, fully executed licence and sub-licence agreement with arm's-length royalty formula, board minutes approving the licence, group organisation chart, OECD-compliant transfer pricing study, country-by-country economic substance file, annual financial statements in audit-ready format, and a defensible cost- and value-creation analysis.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound wire payments to related parties, licensees, or third parties in jurisdictions or banking corridors that raise sanctions, corruption, or unexplained-funds concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed transaction-declaration form identifying each payee and end-beneficiary, underlying invoice and usage-royalty calculation, executed sub-licence agreement, proof of receipt of prior royalty installments, sanctions and adverse-media screening results, payment-swift exemption letter from the local registered agent, and a written confirmation from the domestic bank's compliance team that the corridor is open.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections should be routed as a single SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder's or parent entity's own account, strictly in the corporate shareholder's legal name, with the remit as 'EQUITY SUBSCRIPTION' or 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' and the Vanuatu entity's registered account reference. The bank will code the transaction under its internal capital-contribution purpose category and will require a board resolution, updated share register, investor KYC pack, and a registered-agent statutory declaration confirming the IC's good standing. If the injection is received in USD and the operating account is USD-denominated, no FX conversion occurs; if a VUV conversion is needed, the domestic bank's FX ticket and dealing confirmation must be preserved as part of the treasury audit trail.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Royalty and sub-licensing fees are cleared principally through SWIFT MT103 payment instructions from the Vanuatu entity's USD account to the beneficiary's bank. For higher-value licence transactions, the beneficiary's importing bank may require a documentary credit; in such cases, a Commercial Letter of Credit issued under UCP600 from a licensed banking institution can be used as collateral-backed settlement rail, usually through the Vanuatu bank's correspondent network in Australia, Singapore, or Hong Kong. All MT103s must carry the underlying licence agreement reference, quote number, and breakdown of principal and taxes, with the outbound purpose narrative describing the applicable patent or trademark royalty settlement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Permissible forwards: plain-vanilla VUV/USD and VUV/EUR outright forwards with an RBV-authorised dealing bank, up to 12 months, supported by documented future royalty cash-flow exposure and an approved treasury hedging policy.

Permissible NDFs: non-deliverable VUV/USD forwards executed with an international banker only where offshore VUV liquidity is insufficient, provided the underlying exposure is evidenced and no speculative open position is created.

Permissible currency swaps: fixed-to-fixed cross-currency swaps matched to the principal and interest or royalty payment schedule of the licence treasury plan, subject to the domestic bank's credit approval and to a board-approved match-funding structure.

Permissible FX options: vanilla annual or semi-annual US/foreign currency options may be used defensively to cap royalty-conversion exposure, but only after the licensed bank confirms the derivative is valid under RBV regulatory expectations and the transaction passes suitability review.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Return and Annual Government Renewal Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Prescribed late filing penalties are applied by VFSC; continued non-compliance for 90 days after the anniversary may result in a notice of intended strike-off, followed by dissolution after the statutory notice period.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Declaration and CDD Refresh
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (maintained for inspection by VFSC under the AML/CFT legal framework)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary of incorporation; completion is required before filing the annual return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with beneficial-owner record refresh may expose the registered agent and the company to AML/CFT administrative penalties; repeated defaults may lead to agent deregistration and consequential strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for an unlicensed Vanuatu International Company. An audit becomes mandatory if the company holds a VFSC financial services licence, its articles of association require an audit, or shareholders holding at least 10% of the voting rights pass a resolution demanding an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed Vanuatu statutory accounting framework applies to International Companies; financial records must only reflect transactions and financial position with reasonable accuracy. If voluntary financial statements are prepared, IFRS or IFRS for SMEs is the acceptable professional benchmark.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must conduct an annual refresh of beneficial ownership and customer due diligence records under the Vanuatu AML/CFT legal framework. There is no public UBO filing with VFSC; however, any share transfer or change in ownership must be recorded promptly in the register of members and reported to the registered agent so the updated UBO declaration can be executed.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – USD 4,000 when a voluntary independent audit or certified financial review is commissioned

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; the International Company (IC) is unconditionally exempt under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] from all forms of income taxation.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: None applicable - the zero-rate regime is the permanent statutory baseline; no tax holidays or preferential deductions are required. The IC is also exempt from capital gains tax, stamp duty, and withholding tax on cross-border transactions. The 12.5% VAT applies only to domestic supplies of goods and services, which is outside this offshore IP-licensing model.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC AR-1 - Annual Return of an International Company; submitted by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent through the VFSC e-Registry online portal with simultaneous payment of the annual retention fee. No national corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation (the Anniversary Date); the annual retention fee is payable at the same deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name and VFSC registration number of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact registered name as per the Certificate of Incorporation; non-resident ICs quote the 'IC' registration number prefix.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu (physical address of the registered agent or dedicated office).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PO Box alone is insufficient; the address must be capable of receiving legal process.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed registered agent name, licence number, and contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident wholly owned ICs, the agent executes the filing; a letter of engagement authorising the agent must remain on file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and company secretary: full legal names, residential addresses, and appointment dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individual or corporate directors are permitted; nominee directors must be disclosed to the agent for the beneficial ownership register.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Share capital structure: authorised capital, issued shares, class rights, and immediate shareholders.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) details on the parallel BO register; the IC Act requires no minimum capital.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compliance declaration confirming the IC has not carried on business in Vanuatu with residents and, where relevant, confirmation of economic substance filing obligations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the IP HoldCo, attach a short statement that sub-licensing is performed exclusively outside Vanuatu.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and late payment attract a 10% surcharge on the annual retention fee; continued non-compliance for 3 months or more exposes the IC to administrative strike-off from the VFSC Register, with restoration fees of up to VUV 50,000 (approx. USD 420) plus director disqualification risk.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC ESR-01 - Economic Substance Notification and Return; filed online or via the registered agent for ICs engaged in a 'relevant activity' (including IP holding).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 6 months after the accounting reference date (or such other period as the VFSC prescribes); first filing is aligned with the relevant activity's first accounting period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of the IC and confirmation that it is carrying on a relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select 'Intellectual property holding or licensing' as the relevant activity; tick the IP-box pathway if commercial holding of patents and trademarks is the core business.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount of gross revenue and net income derived from the relevant activity during the period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report royalty income net of inter-facing sub-license payments; all figures in VUV with FX reconciliation where income is received in USD.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical presence: address and nature of premises occupied in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A dedicated serviced office, not merely the registered agent's address, must be disclosed for IP companies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Employees: number, qualifications, functions, and location of employees engaged in the relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IP IC must evidence Vanuatu-based personnel performing CIGA, including licensing negotiation, strategy, and supervision of sub-licensees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenditure incurred in Vanuatu for the relevant activity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State payroll, rent, legal, and administration outflows proportionate to IP-derived net income; a materially higher foreign cost base will flag disproportionate substance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or knowingly false filings attract fines of up to VUV 5,000,000 (approx. USD 42,000) plus daily default penalties; officers may additionally face up to 2 years' imprisonment; continued failure triggers compulsory strike-off.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, no branch remittance tax, and no tax on distributions of an International Company to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: N/A - Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement (DTA) network; only tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) exist (e.g., with Australia). Because the domestic WHT rate is zero, no treaty-relief application, TRC, or corresponding certificate is required in Vanuatu. The practical protocol is: (1) declare the dividend by board resolution in Vanuatu; (2) remit via SWIFT with a covering director's certificate; (3) furnish the parent jurisdiction with the IC's Certificate of Good Standing, audited financial statements, and ESR confirmation as evidence of the payment's offshore character.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate 0% on outgoing royalties and interest paid by the IC to non-residents; no VAT applies to outbound IP licences exploited outside Vanuatu (export outside the 12.5% VAT net). On inbound sub-licensable IP acquisitions and intercompany loans, no Vanuatu WHT or stamp duty is chargeable.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No Vanuatu statutory threshold exists (VUV 0 - the regime does not legislate transfer pricing). Practical group-level threshold: maintain a contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation package (Local File and benchmarking study) whenever annual intercompany royalty flows exceed VUV 12,000,000 (approx. USD 100,000), to support the foreign parent's deduction and CFC defence.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable - Vanuatu's economic substance legislation (enacted 2021 under the International Companies Act framework and administered by the VFSC) classifies IP holding and licensing as a 'relevant activity' attracting the full substance test. The IC must annually demonstrate: (i) management and control exercised in Vanuatu (quorate board meetings physically held in Vanuatu with minutes); (ii) adequate physical premises; (iii) adequate qualified employees performing all core income-generating activities (CIGA); and (iv) operating expenditure in Vanuatu proportionate to IP-derived income. The reduced equity-holding test does not apply to IP HoldCos. The ESR return is filed annually; outside the ESR framework, the pre-2021 rule exempting ICs from all taxes remains in force.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Sham Transaction (Tax Evasion Pattern)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Zero-substance IP conduit: the IC is incorporated with nominee directors, maintains no Vanuatu employees or office, holds no board meetings, and merely channels royalty payments to shareholders while the licensor's substantive decisions are made abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu: ESR assessment with penalty up to VUV 5,000,000, daily default fines, and strike-off; VFSC may also report the IC to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU). Parent jurisdiction: the entire royalty flow may be recharacterised as a sham dividend or as attributable to the parent's permanent establishment, triggering full corporate tax, interest, and 20-40% accuracy penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign knowingly false ESR/UBO filings face fines up to VUV 10,000,000 and/or 2 years' imprisonment; in the foreign parent state, courts may pierce the corporate veil and impose civil restitution, travel bans, and criminal tax-fraud sentences on the parent's officers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain an accurate beneficial ownership register, failure to file the register with the VFSC, or commingling of IP royalty income with unrelated third-party funds in the IC's bank account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines under Vanuatu's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act up to VUV 10,000,000 for the entity and up to 5 years' imprisonment for officers; the FIU may freeze the IC's SWIFT accounts and require production of all licence agreements and underlying IP registrations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Knowing contravention triggers director-level prosecution, personal fines, asset-freezing orders, immigration watchlisting and travel bans, and disqualification from acting as a director in any VFSC-regulated entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC licenses its IP to, or receives income from, a resident of Vanuatu, or carries on any business within Vanuatu other than the permitted offshore activities, breaching the IC Act's restriction on domestic operation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of IC registration; the entity is reclassified as a domestic company under the Companies Act and becomes potentially liable to Vanuatu VAT (12.5%), business licence fees, stamp duty, and penalties in addition to fines for the unauthorised activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers knowingly permitting domestic business may be personally liable for the unpaid taxes and penalties of the company and for criminal fines; the VFSC may impose director bans and seek civil recovery.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC sets the intercompany royalty to its foreign sub-licensees at 70-90% of gross revenue with no CUP or TNMM benchmarking, stripping the group's taxable margin in high-tax jurisdictions while retaining no Vanuatu substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: No Vanuatu CIT consequence (zero-rate), but the foreign tax authority will adjust the royalty deduction, recharacterise the excess as an equity contribution or payment for intangibles, impose 10-20% accuracy penalties, and may assert accrued withholding or diverted-income taxes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Signing officers of the group that prepare or rely on unsupported break-up valuations risk civil restitution of the underpaid foreign taxes and criminal exposure for tax evasion where false pricing documents are knowingly produced.
